title: A Ling-3.1-flash lighthouse scene at dusk
author: PoemOk2356
selftext:
A striped lighthouse, one rocky island, rolling water and circling gulls make up this Ling-3.1-flash scene. The full 48-second recording moves from a wide view of the coast into the tower and shoreline, then back out over the sea.

The beam keeps sweeping while the waves and birds follow their own motion. That gives the scene something to watch at each camera distance: white surf around the rocks up close, then the island's silhouette against the sunset from farther away. 

The original scene brief centred on those few elements and a calm mood. For a similar build, give the model both the objects and what each one should do, then ask for a complete browser scene.

An adapted starting prompt: “Create a calm, polished 3D scene of a rocky island at dusk in a single HTML file. Build the island, lighthouse, sea and gulls in code. Animate rolling waves, white surf around the rocks, a rotating lighthouse beam and birds circling overhead. Include camera views that reveal both the shoreline detail and the whole island.”
